endpoints.desc: Chat and model-supported image/audio/video answers. file_url uses native document text, or rendered PDF pages for a selected image-capable package with projector. Auto uses the configured slot, not automatic media-capability matching.

params.name: messages
params.desc: Conversation turns. content is text or ordered parts: text, image_url, audio_url, input_audio, file_url, video_url. Media capabilities/projectors must match the selected model.

default.content: Hello! Explain what a local AI engine does.

params.name: model
params.desc: Model ID to invoke, or 'auto' to use the active model loaded in the chat or vision slot.

params.name: stream
params.desc: Whether to stream tokens incrementally via Server-Sent Events (SSE).

params.name: temperature
params.desc: Sampling temperature (0.0 to 2.0). Lower values produce deterministic output; higher values increase variety.

params.name: max_tokens
params.desc: Maximum number of tokens to generate in response (alias: n_predict).

params.name: think_mode
params.desc: Thinking on or off: 'auto' / 'on' = the model may think and decides itself (as in llama.cpp, enable_thinking = true), 'off' = no thinking. Missing = the user's saved setting.

params.name: reasoning_effort
params.desc: Thinking token budget: 'auto' (= high), 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'max', or a number of tokens. Low / medium / high are a share of the room (25% / 50% / 75%, at most 2048 / 8192 / 32768 tokens, editable in settings); room = context left after the prompt minus the answer's reserve, so the answer always fits. A number bigger than the room is lowered to it (engine.thinking.capped = true). When the budget runs out the engine closes the thinking block and the model answers. Missing = the user's saved setting.

params.name: reasoning_budget_message
params.desc: Text written before the end-of-thinking tag when the budget runs out (llama.cpp --reasoning-budget-message), so the model wraps up instead of stopping mid-thought. '' = no text. Missing = the user's saved setting.

params.name: skip_reasoning
params.desc: Bypasses the reasoning monologue phase entirely for lower latency.

params.name: top_p
params.desc: Nucleus sampling probability mass cutoff threshold (0.0 - 1.0).

params.name: top_k
params.desc: Limits token candidate pool to top K highest probabilities.

params.name: min_p
params.desc: Minimum token probability threshold scaled relative to the most likely token (0.0 - 1.0).

params.name: repetition_penalty
params.desc: Penalizes repetitive token sequences (alias: repeat_penalty). 1.0 is neutral.

params.name: presence_penalty
params.desc: Penalizes new tokens based on their presence in generated text so far.

params.name: frequency_penalty
params.desc: Penalizes new tokens proportionally to their frequency in generated text so far.

params.name: temporary_chat
params.desc: Privacy isolation mode: 'lite' (no persistent memory writes) or 'strict' (complete brain and memory bypass).

params.name: session_id
params.desc: Session identifier used to maintain multi-turn chat history and dynamic session tool bindings.

params.name: llama
params.desc: llama.cpp load settings for this request (llama.cpp names). Missing fields = automatic (planner + saved settings). Fields: n_ctx (0 auto, -1 max, N tokens), n_gpu_layers (alias ngl; -1 all, 0 CPU, N), n_cpu_moe, cache_type_k / cache_type_v ('auto', 'f16', 'q8_0', 'q4_0'; both the same), flash_attn ('auto', 'on', 'off'), n_batch, n_ubatch, n_threads, n_threads_batch, use_mmap, offload_kqv, op_offload, vram_buffer_gb. n_gpu_layers / n_cpu_moe / offload_kqv bypass the planner. A value different from the loaded model's reloads it. Unknown field names are rejected.

params.name: seed
params.desc: Random seed for reproducible, deterministic token generation.

params.name: stop
params.desc: List of string stop tokens that halt generation immediately when matched.

params.name: keep_alive
params.desc: Retention in minutes, not seconds: 0 unloads; -1/omitted retains; positive values expire after completion.

params.name: response_format
params.desc: Structured JSON output enforcement, e.g. {'type': 'json_object'}.

params.name: tools
params.desc: List of available tool definitions (Function Calling) callable via <tool_call> XML.

params.name: tool_choice
params.desc: 'none' gives the model no tools for this request; any other value lets the model decide.

params.name: tool_search
params.desc: Suggest installed, switched-on tools that fit the message (short cards; the model loads one with load_tool). false leaves suggestions out.

params.name: history
params.desc: 'client' (default): the request carries the whole conversation. 'engine': send only new messages; the Engine adds the chat's logged transcript (needs session_id).

params.name: history_mode
params.desc: 'recent' (default): whole history; compaction first, then the oldest turns are dropped when it does not fit. 'adaptive': the newest recent_turns_min turns, older messages through recall. 'none': only the system prompt and the current message (plus recall).

params.name: context_policy
params.desc: Planner fields for this request only (recent_turns_min, evidence_cap_pct, suggestions_cap_pct, margin_pct, compact_at_pct, compact_to_pct); unknown or invalid ones are ignored.

params.name: kv_reuse
params.desc: KV matching: 'prefix' keeps only the common prefix; 'chunk' also moves shared chunks (llama-server --cache-reuse). Default: chunk only when the Engine dropped old turns to fit.

params.name: grammar
params.desc: BNF / GBNF formal grammar specification to enforce strict syntactical output constraints.

params.name: chat_template_kwargs
params.desc: Additional keyword parameters passed directly into Jinja chat tokenizer templates.

params.name: logit_bias
params.desc: Map of token IDs to bias weights (-100 to +100) to adjust token emission probabilities.

endpoints.desc: Text-to-speech with a compatible installed ONNX package or GGUF speech backbone plus matching codec/projector. Select package-specific voices/languages. GGUF CPU/Auto/GPU split uses engine settings; no device field in this payload.

params.name: input
params.desc: The text string to synthesize into speech audio.
params.default: Hello, welcome to Cluaiz Engine. you can now run ai.

params.name: model
params.desc: Installed ONNX TTS or GGUF speech package with an audio-generation projector (e.g. Piper, Kokoro, Qwen3-TTS Base GGUF). Model support does not imply verified voice quality.

params.name: voice
params.desc: Package speaker ID from /audio/voices, or default. GGUF reference_source accepts real reference audio sources; Audio8 reference_profile uses package-local encoded profiles. IDs are not interchangeable.

params.name: stream
params.desc: SSE response: Kokoro/Piper send settled sentence audio; GGUF and Audio8 send newly generated audio parts, then the whole WAV. Closing the consumer stops output; other families depend on their runtime.

params.name: keep_alive
params.desc: Retention in minutes after completion: positive values expire, 0 unloads, -1 retains. GGUF omitted/-1 retains until replacement/shutdown; errors release it. Older timers cannot unload a newer request. Speech stays separate from chat.

params.name: task
params.desc: text_to_speech or speech_to_text. Omit or auto to infer from input_source.type.

params.name: model
params.desc: Installed TTS package for text input, or STT package for audio input. Defaults to the active slot or first eligible package.

params.name: input_source
params.desc: { "type": "text", "data": "..." } for speech synthesis, or an audio type with a data URI / authorized local path / allowed URL for transcription.

params.name: parameters
params.desc: Task options such as speed, voice_id, language, languages, timestamps. Unsupported options for the selected task return 400.

params.name: stream
params.desc: Server-Sent Events output, as on the task-specific endpoint.

params.name: keep_alive
params.desc: Retention in minutes after completion: positive values expire, 0 unloads, -1 retains.

examples.title: cURL (POSIX shell)
examples.code:
curl --fail-with-body http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/audio/execute \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLUAIZ_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  --data-binary @request.json

# Save the Body Payload as request.json first.
# Replace the sample model ID with a real installed ID.

examples.title: Python (requests)
examples.code:
import json
import os
import requests

payload = json.loads(r'''{
  "task": "text_to_speech",
  "model": "<installed-tts-model-id>",
  "input_source": {
    "type": "text",
    "data": "Hello! This is one complete narration."
  },
  "parameters": {
    "speed": 1
  },
  "stream": false,
  "keep_alive": 0
}''')
res = requests.post(
    'http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/audio/execute',
    headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['CLUAIZ_TOKEN']}"},
    json=payload,
    timeout=600,
)
res.raise_for_status()
print(res.json()['task'])
